query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
result: 60 tables tb001 to tb060 with opaque columns cl0001 to cl0420; declared types and foreign keys are retained and used to group tables into nine source datasets.

query: SELECT * FROM tb003 LIMIT 2; SELECT * FROM tb001 LIMIT 2; SELECT * FROM tb002 LIMIT 3
result: tb003 holds school identity, status, county, district, address, type codes, category, flags, coordinates and administrator fields; tb001 holds academic year, grades and enrollment and meal metrics; tb002 holds grade 12 enrollment, test takers, reading/math/writing averages and the count scoring 1500 or above.

query: SELECT cl0019,cl0020,cl0021,cl0022,cl0023,cl0024,cl0025,cl0026,cl0027,cl0028 FROM tb001 WHERE cl0019>0 LIMIT 5
result: Ratios confirm the column roles: cl0021 equals cl0020/cl0019, cl0023 equals cl0022/cl0019, cl0026 equals cl0025/cl0024 and cl0028 equals cl0027/cl0024. Distinct provision values include Multiple Provision Types.
validation_method: ratio cross-check and grouped value counts

query: SELECT cl0065,cl0066,COUNT(*) FROM tb003 GROUP BY 1,2; same for cl0067/cl0068, cl0069/cl0070, cl0075, cl0076
result: District types 54 Unified (10190), 52 Elementary (4378), 00 County Office (1703), 56 High School (1079), 31 State Special Schools (6). School types include 62 Intermediate/Middle and 66 High. Categories include SSS State Special School and TRAD Traditional. Virtual flag values F, N, P and blank; magnet flag 1 and 0.

query: SELECT cl0035,cl0036,cl0037,cl0038,cl0039,cl0040 FROM tb002 ORDER BY cl0035 DESC LIMIT 5
result: cl0035 is grade 12 enrollment, cl0036 is test takers, cl0037 to cl0039 are reading, math and writing averages and cl0040 is the count scoring 1500 or above.

query: SELECT MIN(cl0078),MAX(cl0078),MIN(cl0077),MAX(cl0077) FROM tb003; SELECT cl0077,cl0078,cl0079,cl0080,cl0081 FROM tb003 WHERE cl0079<>'' LIMIT 3
result: Latitude ranges 32.5 to 44.2 and longitude ranges -124.3 to -83.8, all negative for California. Administrator first name, last name and e-mail are present in the school row.

query: grouped counts on tb006.cl0164, tb006.cl0165, tb004.cl0147, tb004.cl0093, tb004.cl0121
